title: Veken Innovation Award Winner 95oz/2.8L Cat Water Fountain, C1 Classic
say: Customers find the pet water fountain easy to assemble, use, and maintain, with their cats loving it and finding it easy to clean. The functionality and value for money receive mixed reviews - while some say it works great and is worth the money, others report it stops working and consider it not worth the cost. The fountain's reliability and noise level also get mixed feedback, with some saying it's super quiet while others find it noisy. Customers report durability issues, with the pump breaking after 5 months of use.
